Unpublished draft of Copy All Note. 0.1.1 is the first public release.

- Header button and **Copy entire note** copy the open buffer, including unsaved edits.
- Keep or remove leading YAML. Optionally add the note title as an H1 after retained frontmatter.
- Split panes and pop-out windows, without reading the file from disk.
- Configurable icon, success notice, and header-button visibility.

The 0.1.0 manifest declared Obsidian 1.5.0. That version was not tested. 0.1.1 raised the minimum to 1.13.7.

No network requests or telemetry. Note text is read only when you copy.
